correctness.rationale: The run-entrance chain is a uniform contraction with constant B=exp(-mu h)<1 and stationary exit Y in [a,L], a>0; Y independent of subsequent Lomax inactive U. Invariant alternating renewal reward divides expected occupation by m=h+E[U]. Exact off-density is E[S(log(Y/x)/mu)]/(mu m x), and on-density remains uniformly bounded near zero. A uniform logarithm squeeze gives both limits, exact C, no atom and all divergent inverse moments. No finite simulation is used to prove an asymptotic. Three finite parameter diagnostics passed by replaying the packaged checker.

value.rationale: The precise singularity class and finite sharp coefficient quantify occupation near a physically preferred confinement point for long-rest intermittent swimmers. It distinguishes the heavy-tail equilibrium residence mechanism from algebraic central clustering under memoryless switching, proves absence of a central atom despite near-inverse-linear blowup, and determines divergent inverse spatial moments. The scale-independent coefficient and stability against any stationary entrance Y bounded in [a,L] are meaningful structural facts rather than a parameter substitution. Model restrictions are explicit.
